description: Generate the canonical Magnifica Humanitas AI system prompt — ready to paste into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or any AI assistant. Call this when the user wants Catholic family values in their AI assistant, mentions wanting "Catholic AI guidance", or asks to generate a "family AI prompt". Three sizes via `tier`: compact (≈110 tokens) fits ChatGPT Custom Instructions (1500-char limit); default (≈215 tokens, returned when tier is omitted) is the balanced kernel and the right choice for most system-prompt fields; full (≈2,100–2,600 tokens) is the complete 13-principle framework and the ONLY tier where `audiences` applies. Use `lang` to pick one of 15 supported languages — pick the language the AI will be addressed in, NOT necessarily the user's UI language. Use `audiences` (comma-separated: adults,teenagers,children) to specialize for mixed-age families — set tier=full with it, or it has no effect. After returning, instruct the user to paste the `data.compass` field into their assistant's Custom Instructions field. The response's `_links` field points at related resources (principles, traceability, wizard) the agent can chain to.

audiences.description: Comma-separated audience sections to append. Use 'adults' (default), 'teenagers' (13-17), 'children' (under 13). Combine for mixed-age families, e.g. 'adults,teenagers'. Applied ONLY when tier='full' — compact and default are size-constrained kernels with no audience sections.

lang.description: BCP 47 language tag for the prompt. Default "en". Pick the language the AI will be addressed in.

tier.description: 'compact' (≈110 tokens): minimal kernel, fits ChatGPT Custom Instructions (1500-char limit). 'default' (≈215 tokens): balanced kernel — use unless there is a reason not to. 'full' (≈2,100–2,600 tokens): complete framework; the only tier where `audiences` applies. Sizes measured on the English text; other languages vary.

name: get_default_compass
